findings.text: Default repository is still mgalpert/msgblast after the move. Fail-closed: every Studio job is refused until MSGBLAST_STUDIO_REPOSITORY is set in the runner's .env. Change the default in a follow-up.
config.sh --url still names the old repository; the 'If the repository moves' section describes the move as future.
Says to look under 'Set up runner' for 'Studio runner accepted'; job-started hook output appears under 'Set up job'.
REPO pins the stale default. Missing cases: no GITHUB_EVENT_PATH, malformed JSON, pull_request with head.repo null (code handles them, tests don't prove it).

One persistent derived-data folder is shared by same-repo PR branches and main; a write-access branch could seed build products reused by a later main build. Docs should name this route under the write-access trust assumption.
workflow_dispatch allowed from any ref; equivalent to the same-repo PR path, covered by the write-access caveat. runner=studio does not widen it.
merge_group branch is dead until validate.yml gets a merge_group trigger; pushed gh-readonly-queue branches are still refused by the push check.
runs-on expression is correct: fork PRs and runner=hosted get xcode-27. test_validate_workflow.py matches the string rather than evaluating it; the hook is the real guard.

tests: Reviewer ran python3 -I -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_*.py' at the head: 173 tests OK, 3 skipped.
notes: Reviewer read the hook, test_studio_job_hook.py, docs/studio-runner.md and the validate.yml diff in full and found no path for fork PRs, non-main pushes, tags or other events to reach the Studio past the installed hook. Studio runner itself not run.
